title: Tenant is the same entity in lease, grid offer and PPA
why: Rights and obligations only benefit the project if the same company holds them all.
how: The tenant, grid customer and PPA generator are compared after name normalisation.

citation.quote: Brackenfield Solar Limited, a company registered in England and Wales (the "Tenant")

evidence.heading: Parties
evidence.paragraph_text: This Lease is made on 15 December 2025 between JOHN HARTLEY of Bracken Farm, Wickham (the "Landlord") and Brackenfield Solar Limited, a company registered in England and Wales (the "Tenant").

evidence.heading: Offer details
evidence.paragraph_text: This Connection Offer is made by Fenland Distribution Networks plc to Brackenfield Solar Limited.
